title: ref.unguarded@1
description: A ref change the forge's record shows that no guarded call named (#46), such as a push a script made inside `npm test`: the ref, what it now holds, who the forge says pushed it, and the session's call that was running, if any. The forge reports it, so an agent's word never writes it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

ref.description: The ref that changed, as the forge names it: refs/heads/feature.

commit.description: What the ref holds now: all zeros when the change deleted it.

pusher.description: The account the forge recorded pushing it, or null when it recorded none.

call.description: The agent's ID for the call that was running, as its tool.before has it; null when no session's call was.

command.description: That call's command; null when no session's call was running.
